title: Cell Explorer: Streamlit version only (streamlit_version.py); the Voila/Jupyter notebook version was not explored

author.name: Shuyib
author.field: Microscopy / histopathology image analysis (H&E histology, fluorescence cell imaging)

provenance.origin: github.com/Shuyib/cell-explorer-tool at be0ddd7a49c4, github (github: topic:streamlit topic:medical-imaging archived:false (page 1))

notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). Upload JPG microscopy images and pick one. Each image is resized to 500x500. Crop and zoom on a region with X/Y/Zoom sliders, then adjust contrast, brightness and sharpness. Save the 500x500 result, a free-text description (TXT) and the processing parameters (JSON) on the server. Rename Files then tags all three with a shared suffix so the next image's record does not overwrite them. This tree covers only the Streamlit entry point, not the Voila notebook (image-processing-raw-final.ipynb) that the repository is named after. Data used in the run: stock. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
